description: 震災時火災における避難場所等の一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都都市整備局. 【東京都都市整備局】 震災時火災における避難場所等の指定（第8回）における避難場所等の一覧です。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都都市整備局. Its tags are デジタルツイン. It offers 39 resource(s) in pdf, shp, xls. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
